update.foreach:
UPDATE third_market_category_field
market_category_id = #{item.marketCategoryId,jdbcType=BIGINT},
name_code = #{item.nameCode,jdbcType=BIGINT},
third_source_id = #{item.thirdSourceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
reference_id = #{item.referenceId,jdbcType=BIGINT},
order_no = #{item.orderNo,jdbcType=INTEGER},
data_source_code = #{item.dataSourceCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
create_time = #{item.createTime,jdbcType=BIGINT},
modify_time = #{item.modifyTime,jdbcType=BIGINT},
WHERE id = #{item.id,jdbcType=BIGINT}

mapper.select: SELECT LOWER(i18n_t.text) oddsName, t_field.third_source_id thirdSourceId, t_field.reference_id referenceId FROM standard_market_category_field s_field INNER JOIN third_market_category_field t_field ON s_field.id = t_field.reference_id INNER JOIN third_sport_market_category sport_t ON sport_t.market_category_id = t_field.market_category_id INNER JOIN i18n_market_category i18n_t ON i18n_t.name_code = t_field.name_code AND i18n_t.language_type = 'en' WHERE sport_t.sport_id = 1 AND s_field.market_category_id = #{marketCategoryId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND t_field.data_source_code = #{dataSourceCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
